articles.title: State of emergency in Crimea as Ukraine focuses pressure on ‘jewel in Putin’s crown’
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has acknowledged that Ukraine's persistent drone attacks on Russia's energy infrastructure are indeed having an effect. Speaking to the ruling United Russia party on June 28, Putin's admission is a rare public recognition from the Kremlin regarding the success of Ukrainian strikes. This highlights the ongoing conflict's evolving tactics and the significant impact on Russia's vital infrastructure.

articles.title: Indian Navy foils piracy attack on merchant ship in Gulf of Aden, crew including an Indian sailor safe
articles.summary: Indian Navy warship INS Trikand successfully thwarted a piracy attempt on a merchant vessel in the strategically important Gulf of Aden on Wednesday night. This operation underscores the Indian Navy's crucial role in ensuring maritime security and freedom of navigation in international waters, demonstrating its commitment to combating piracy and protecting global trade routes. Such deployments enhance India's stature as a net security provider.

articles.title: Shark attack on Alabama teen inspires the start of a national alert system
articles.summary: Fifteen-year-old Lulu Gribbin survived a harrowing shark attack off Florida's coast, an incident that nearly claimed her life. She suffered severe injuries, tragically losing her left hand and a portion of her right leg. The article details her survival story, beginning with her unawareness of the impending danger when she entered the water.

articles.title: 7 indoor plants that may help repel snakes and lizards from home
articles.summary: Lemongrass, rich in citronella, emits a powerful citrus scent. This strong aroma significantly interferes with snakes' keen sense of smell, which they rely heavily upon for hunting. Overpowering smells like that of lemongrass can disorient snakes, disrupting their ability to locate prey. Research suggests this natural property makes lemongrass a potential deterrent against snakes, exploiting their olfactory reliance for defence.
